_comment: Sample private rules. Copy next to your config, point private_rules at it, and replace these harmless samples with your own red lines. Never commit your real file. match: shell (the command) | path (file a tool touches, or a path in a shell command; forward slashes) | content (text being written). access: write (default; only blocks calls that change something) | any (also blocks reads). pattern is a JavaScript regex, case-insensitive unless flags says otherwise.

rules.reason: the example archive folder is read-only for agents
the example diary folder is off limits
agents do not shut the machine down
text marked DO-NOT-PUBLISH stays out of files agents write
